## *Data*
```{r}
# Read the CSV files
data <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_pilot.csv"))
study <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_studies_pilot.csv"))
concept <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_long_pilot.csv"))
```


# *Basic summary of guideline level details* 
```{r}
# Unique Guidelines 
number_unique_guide <- study %>% 
  distinct(study_id) %>% 
  nrow() ##  

# Unique Checklist
number_unique_checklist <- data %>% 
distinct(checklist) %>% 
  nrow() ##

# overall cumulative counts
guide_per_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id) %>%
  count(year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(year = full_seq(year, 1), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n))

  
```

## Figure 1b
```{r}
# settings
lollipop_years <- c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2025)
guideline_levels <- c("Update", "Extension", "Original")
legend_order <- c("Original", "Extension", "Update")

pal <- c(
  "Original" = "#54478c",
  "Extension" = "#048ba8",
  "Update" = "#16db93"
)

# cumulative counts by guideline type
guide_type_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(guideline_extension)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id, guideline_extension) %>%
  mutate(
    guideline_extension = tolower(guideline_extension),
    guideline_extension = case_when(
      guideline_extension %in% c("original", "origional") ~ "Original",
      guideline_extension == "update" ~ "Update",
      guideline_extension == "extension" ~ "Extension",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(guideline_extension)
    ),
    guideline_extension = factor(guideline_extension, levels = guideline_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(year, guideline_extension, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    guideline_extension,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(guideline_extension, year) %>%
  group_by(guideline_extension) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# smooth each category separately
smooth_type_year <- guide_type_year %>%
  group_by(guideline_extension) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_seq <- seq(min(.x$year), max(.x$year), length.out = 500)
    spline_fn <- splinefun(.x$year, .x$cum_n, method = "monoH.FC")

    tibble(
      year = x_seq,
      cum_n = spline_fn(x_seq)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# lollipop labels from overall totals
lollipop_data <- guide_per_year %>%
  filter(year %in% lollipop_years)

max_cum <- max(guide_per_year$cum_n, na.rm = TRUE)
offset <- max_cum * 0.018
label_offset <- max_cum * 0.03

count_cum_type <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = smooth_type_year,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n, fill = guideline_extension),
    position = "stack",
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, xend = year, y = 0, yend = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset + label_offset, label = comma(cum_n)),
    vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.3,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal,
    breaks = legend_order,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, colour = NA),
      keyheight = unit(0.55, "cm"),
      keywidth = unit(0.55, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = lollipop_years,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 10),
    labels = comma,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 60),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Publication Year",
    y = "Cumulative number of reporting guidelines"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0.9),
      color = "grey70"
    ),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10.5),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.08, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 6, 12)
  )

count_cum_type

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "count_cum_type.jpg"),
  plot     = count_cum_type,
  width    = 10.8,
  height   = 11.0,
  units    = "cm",
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# settings

    discipline = case_when(
      discipline == "medicine" ~ "Medicine",
```

## Figure Sx
```{r}
# settings
lollipop_years <- c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020, 2025)

methodology_levels <- c(
  "Systematic review/meta-analysis",
  "Qualitative reviews",
  "Abstract",
  "Within-review parts",
  "Scoping review/Systematic map",
  "Other"
)

legend_order <- methodology_levels

pal <- c(
  "Systematic review/meta-analysis" = "#54478c",
  "Qualitative reviews" = "#048ba8",
  "Abstract" = "#16db93",
  "Within-review parts" = "#b9e769",
  "Scoping review/Systematic map" = "#efea5a",
  "Other" = "#f29e4c"
)

# cumulative counts by grouped methodology
methodology_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(methodology)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id, methodology) %>%
  mutate(
    methodology_group = str_squish(str_to_lower(methodology)),
    methodology_group = case_when(
      str_detect(methodology_group, "scoping review|scoping reviews|systematic map") ~ "Scoping review/Systematic map",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "abstracts") ~ "Abstract",
      methodology_group == "search strategies" ~ "Within-review parts",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "qualitative|meta-ethnography|mixed-methods|realist review|meta-narrative review") ~ "Qualitative reviews",
      str_detect(methodology_group, "systematic review|systematic reviews|meta-analyses|overview of systematic reviews|rapid review|living systematic reviews") ~ "Systematic review/meta-analysis",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    methodology_group = factor(methodology_group, levels = methodology_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(year, methodology_group, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    methodology_group,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(methodology_group, year) %>%
  group_by(methodology_group) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# smooth each methodology group separately
smooth_methodology_year <- methodology_year %>%
  group_by(methodology_group) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_seq <- seq(min(.x$year), max(.x$year), length.out = 500)
    spline_fn <- splinefun(.x$year, .x$cum_n, method = "monoH.FC")

    tibble(
      year = x_seq,
      cum_n = spline_fn(x_seq)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# overall cumulative totals for lollipops
guide_per_year <- study %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  distinct(year, study_id) %>%
  count(year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n))

lollipop_data <- guide_per_year %>%
  filter(year %in% lollipop_years)

max_cum <- max(guide_per_year$cum_n, na.rm = TRUE)
offset <- max_cum * 0.018
label_offset <- max_cum * 0.03

count_cum_methodology <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = smooth_methodology_year,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n, fill = methodology_group),
    position = "stack",
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, xend = year, y = 0, yend = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lollipop_data,
    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(

    aes(x = year, y = cum_n + offset + label_offset, label = comma(cum_n)),
    vjust = 0,
    fontface = "bold",

  ) +
```

# *Basic summary of item level details*

## Total items, total concepts and unique concepts

### Total items
```{r}
length(data$reporting_item)  # Number of items

item_per_section <- data %>% 
  group_by(standardised_section) %>% 
  summarise(n =n())


section_order <- c(
  "Other",
  "Discussion",
  "Results",
  "Methodology",
  "Introduction",
  "Abstract",
  "Title"
)

item_per_section_plot <- item_per_section %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = str_squish(standardised_section),
    standardised_section = case_when(
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "other" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ standardised_section
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(standardised_section) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = factor(
      standardised_section,
      levels = section_order
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section))

bar_section <- ggplot(item_per_section_plot, aes(x = standardised_section, y = n)) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#BD4D52",
    width = 0.72
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(n)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of items"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
  )

bar_section

paper_items_by_section <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section), !is.na(reporting_item), !is.na(study_id)) %>%
  left_join(
    study %>% select(study_id, DOI, methodology, discipline),
    by = "study_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_section = str_squish(as.character(standardised_section)),
    reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item)),
    DOI = str_squish(as.character(DOI)),
    methodology = str_squish(as.character(methodology)),
    discipline = str_squish(as.character(discipline)),
    standardised_section = case_when(
      str_to_lower(standardised_section) == "other" ~ "Other information",
      TRUE ~ standardised_section
    ),
    standardised_section = factor(
      standardised_section,
      levels = section_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(standardised_section, study_id, reporting_item) %>%
  group_by(standardised_section) %>%
  mutate(Row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Section = standardised_section,
    Row,
    study_id,
    methodology,
    discipline,
    Item = reporting_item,
    DOI
  )

section_tables <- split(
  paper_items_by_section %>% select(-Section),
  paper_items_by_section$Section
)

```

## Overlapping concepts between items
```{r}
concept_sets <- concept %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(study_id),
    !is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    study %>% select(study_id, year),
    by = "study_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    standardised_reporting_item_elements = str_squish(as.character(standardised_reporting_item_elements)),
    guideline = if_else(!is.na(checklist) & checklist != "", checklist, as.character(study_id))
  ) %>%
  distinct(guideline, study_id, standardised_reporting_item_elements)

set_list <- concept_sets %>%
  group_by(guideline) %>%
  summarise(
    concepts = list(sort(unique(standardised_reporting_item_elements))),
    n_concepts = n_distinct(standardised_reporting_item_elements),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


pairwise_overlap <- combn(set_list$guideline, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  map_dfr(function(x) {
    a <- set_list$concepts[[match(x[1], set_list$guideline)]]
    b <- set_list$concepts[[match(x[2], set_list$guideline)]]

    inter <- intersect(a, b)
    union_ab <- union(a, b)

    tibble(
      guideline_1 = x[1],
      guideline_2 = x[2],
      n_1 = length(a),
      n_2 = length(b),
      shared_n = length(inter),
      unique_1_n = length(setdiff(a, b)),
      unique_2_n = length(setdiff(b, a)),
      jaccard = length(inter) / length(union_ab)
    )
  })

pairwise_overlap %>%
  arrange(desc(jaccard), desc(shared_n))

overlap_stats <- pairwise_overlap %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_jaccard = median(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_jaccard = quantile(jaccard, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_jaccard = quantile(jaccard, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

overlap_stats

overlap_dist <- ggplot(pairwise_overlap, aes(x = jaccard)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "#BD4D52",
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Pairwise Jaccard overlap",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black")
  )



heatmap_data <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_overlap,
  pairwise_overlap %>%
    transmute(
      guideline_1 = guideline_2,
      guideline_2 = guideline_1,
      n_1 = n_2,
      n_2 = n_1,
      shared_n = shared_n,
      unique_1_n = unique_2_n,
      unique_2_n = unique_1_n,
      jaccard = jaccard
    ),
  tibble(
    guideline_1 = set_list$guideline,
    guideline_2 = set_list$guideline,
    n_1 = set_list$n_concepts,
    n_2 = set_list$n_concepts,
    shared_n = set_list$n_concepts,
    unique_1_n = 0,
    unique_2_n = 0,
    jaccard = 1
  )
)

guideline_order <- set_list %>%
  arrange(desc(n_concepts)) %>%
  pull(guideline)

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    guideline_1 = factor(guideline_1, levels = guideline_order),
    guideline_2 = factor(guideline_2, levels = rev(guideline_order))
  )

overlap_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = guideline_1, y = guideline_2, fill = jaccard)) +
```

## Readability 

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 0) helper functions
# =========================================================

calc_ttr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  dplyr::n_distinct(x) / length(x)
}

calc_log_ttr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  n_tokens <- length(x)
  n_types <- dplyr::n_distinct(x)
  if (n_tokens <= 1 || n_types <= 1) return(NA_real_)
  log(n_types) / log(n_tokens)
}

calc_mattr <- function(x, window = 10) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)
  if (n < window) return(calc_ttr(x))
  starts <- seq_len(n - window + 1)
  mean(purrr::map_dbl(starts, ~ calc_ttr(x[.x:(.x + window - 1)])))
}

boot_ci <- function(x, stat_fun, R = 5000, conf = 0.95, seed = 1234) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)

  if (n == 0) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_))
  }

  set.seed(seed)
  reps <- replicate(R, stat_fun(sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
  alpha <- 1 - conf

  c(
    est = stat_fun(x),
    lower = unname(quantile(reps, probs = alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    upper = unname(quantile(reps, probs = 1 - alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

summarise_metric <- function(df, var, R = 5000, conf = 0.95) {
  x <- df[[var]]
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !is.na(x)]

  mean_ci   <- boot_ci(x, mean, R = R, conf = conf)
  median_ci <- boot_ci(x, median, R = R, conf = conf)
  q1_ci     <- boot_ci(x, function(z) quantile(z, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), R = R, conf = conf)
  q3_ci     <- boot_ci(x, function(z) quantile(z, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), R = R, conf = conf)

  tibble(
    metric = var,
    n = length(x),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ci_lower = mean_ci["lower"],
    mean_ci_upper = mean_ci["upper"],
    sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ci_lower = median_ci["lower"],
    median_ci_upper = median_ci["upper"],
    q1 = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_ci_lower = q1_ci["lower"],
    q1_ci_upper = q1_ci["upper"],
    q3 = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_ci_lower = q3_ci["lower"],
    q3_ci_upper = q3_ci["upper"],
    iqr = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 1) source items from concept
# =========================================================

items <- concept %>%
  filter(!is.na(reporting_item)) %>%
  mutate(
    reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item))
  ) %>%
  filter(reporting_item != "") %>%
  distinct(reporting_item) %>%
  mutate(item_id = row_number())

# =========================================================
# 2) tokenization for diversity/repetition
# =========================================================

item_tokens <- items %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, reporting_item)

# =========================================================
# 3) POS tagging for lexical density
# =========================================================
# Run download once if you do not already have the model file.
# If already downloaded, replace model_path with your local .udpipe file.

model_info <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english")
ud_model <- udpipe_load_model(model_info$file_model)

anno <- udpipe_annotate(
  ud_model,
  x = items$reporting_item,
  doc_id = items$item_id
)

anno_df <- as.data.frame(anno) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_id = as.integer(doc_id),
    token = str_squish(as.character(token)),
    upos = as.character(upos)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(token), token != "", !is.na(upos))

content_upos <- c("NOUN", "PROPN", "VERB", "ADJ", "ADV")

lexical_density_stats <- anno_df %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    token_count_pos = n(),
    content_token_count = sum(upos %in% content_upos),
    lexical_density = content_token_count / token_count_pos,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(item_id = doc_id)

# =========================================================
# 4) lexical diversity metrics
# =========================================================

lexdiv_stats <- item_tokens %>%
  group_by(item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    token_count = n(),
    unique_tokens = n_distinct(word),
    ttr = unique_tokens / token_count,
    log_ttr = if_else(
      token_count > 1 & unique_tokens > 1,
      log(unique_tokens) / log(token_count),
      NA_real_
    ),
    mean_word_frequency = token_count / unique_tokens,
    mattr_10 = calc_mattr(word, window = 10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

checklist_tokens <- concept %>%
  filter(!is.na(checklist), !is.na(reporting_item)) %>%
  mutate(
    reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item))
  ) %>%
  filter(reporting_item != "") %>%
  distinct(checklist, reporting_item) %>%
  group_by(checklist) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(checklist, item_order) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, reporting_item)

checklist_level_mattr <- checklist_tokens %>%
  group_by(checklist) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tokens = n(),
    unique_tokens = n_distinct(word),
    mattr_10 = calc_mattr(word, window = 10),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

checklist_level_mattr

# =========================================================
# 5) repetition metrics
# =========================================================

bigram_stats <- items %>%
  unnest_tokens(bigram, reporting_item, token = "ngrams", n = 2) %>%
  group_by(item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bigrams = n(),
    unique_bigrams = n_distinct(bigram),
    repeated_bigram_rate = if_else(
      n_bigrams > 0,
      1 - unique_bigrams / n_bigrams,
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

trigram_stats <- items %>%
  unnest_tokens(trigram, reporting_item, token = "ngrams", n = 3) %>%
  group_by(item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trigrams = n(),
    unique_trigrams = n_distinct(trigram),
    repeated_trigram_rate = if_else(
      n_trigrams > 0,
      1 - unique_trigrams / n_trigrams,
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 6) concepts per item
# =========================================================

concepts_per_item <- concept %>%
  filter(!is.na(reporting_item), !is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements)) %>%
  mutate(
    reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item)),
    standardised_reporting_item_elements = str_squish(as.character(standardised_reporting_item_elements))
  ) %>%
  filter(reporting_item != "", standardised_reporting_item_elements != "") %>%
  group_by(reporting_item) %>%
  summarise(
    concepts_per_item = n_distinct(standardised_reporting_item_elements),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 7) item-level metrics table
# =========================================================

item_metrics <- items %>%
  left_join(lexical_density_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(lexdiv_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(bigram_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(trigram_stats, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(concepts_per_item, by = "reporting_item") %>%
  mutate(
    n_bigrams = coalesce(n_bigrams, 0L),
    repeated_bigram_rate = coalesce(repeated_bigram_rate, 0),
    n_trigrams = coalesce(n_trigrams, 0L),
    repeated_trigram_rate = coalesce(repeated_trigram_rate, 0),
    concepts_per_item = coalesce(concepts_per_item, 0L)
  ) %>%
  select(
    item_id,
    reporting_item,
    token_count,
    token_count_pos,
    content_token_count,
    lexical_density,
    unique_tokens,
    ttr,
    log_ttr,
    mattr_10,
    mean_word_frequency,
    n_bigrams,
    repeated_bigram_rate,
    n_trigrams,
    repeated_trigram_rate,
    concepts_per_item
  )

# =========================================================
# 8) uncertainty summaries for continuous metrics
# =========================================================

metric_vars <- c(
  "token_count",
  "lexical_density",
  "ttr",
  "log_ttr",
  "mattr_10",
  "mean_word_frequency",
  "repeated_bigram_rate",
  "repeated_trigram_rate",
  "concepts_per_item"
)

metric_summaries <- map_dfr(
  metric_vars,
  ~ summarise_metric(item_metrics, .x, R = 5000, conf = 0.95)
)

# =========================================================
# 9) duplicate item rate + exact binomial CI
# =========================================================

duplicate_rows <- concept %>%
  filter(!is.na(reporting_item)) %>%
  mutate(
    reporting_item = str_squish(as.character(reporting_item))
  ) %>%
  filter(reporting_item != "") %>%
  mutate(is_duplicate = duplicated(reporting_item))

dup_n <- nrow(duplicate_rows)
dup_x <- sum(duplicate_rows$is_duplicate)

dup_test <- binom.test(dup_x, dup_n, conf.level = 0.95)

duplicate_rate_summary <- tibble(
  metric = "duplicate_item_rate",
  n = dup_n,
  estimate = unname(dup_test$estimate),
  ci_lower = dup_test$conf.int[1],
  ci_upper = dup_test$conf.int[2],
  duplicates = dup_x,
  unique_items = n_distinct(duplicate_rows$reporting_item)
)

# =========================================================
# 10) compact manuscript-style table
# =========================================================

report_table <- metric_summaries %>%
  mutate(
    mean_with_ci = sprintf(
      "%.3f (95%% CI %.3f to %.3f)",
      mean, mean_ci_lower, mean_ci_upper
    ),
    median_with_ci = sprintf(
      "%.3f (95%% CI %.3f to %.3f)",
      median, median_ci_lower, median_ci_upper
    ),
    q1_with_ci = sprintf(
      "%.3f (95%% CI %.3f to %.3f)",
      q1, q1_ci_lower, q1_ci_upper
    ),
    q3_with_ci = sprintf(
      "%.3f (95%% CI %.3f to %.3f)",
      q3, q3_ci_lower, q3_ci_upper
    ),
    median_iqr = sprintf(
      "%.3f (Q1 %.3f; Q3 %.3f)",
      median, q1, q3
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    metric,
    n,
    mean_with_ci,
    sd,
    median_with_ci,
    q1_with_ci,
    q3_with_ci,
    median_iqr,
    iqr
  )

# =========================================================
# 11) optional rounded display tables
# =========================================================

metric_summaries_rounded <- metric_summaries %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

duplicate_rate_summary_rounded <- duplicate_rate_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

report_table
```
